results.title: A pack cut while a subsystem is unreadable
results.evidence: the monitoring service raised while this pack was cut and `gaps.md` does not mention it. `ContextBuilder` records what it could not read under `ctx['unreadable']`; `ExportPacker.build` reads `ctx.get('_gaps')`, which nothing writes — so the loop that turns context failures into gap entries iterates an empty list every time. Keys read by the packer and never written by the context builder: ['_gaps'
